statements.status_notes: golang.org/x/sys 0.1.0 has a string length overflow issue in NewNTUnicodeString. Fixed in 0.44.0. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in Elasticsearch's compiled Go components and cannot be patched via JAR replacement. Waiting for upstream Elasticsearch update.

golang.org/x/sys 0.1.0 has a string length overflow issue in NewNTUnicodeString. Fixed in 0.44.0. The vulnerable dependency is embedded in Elasticsearch's compiled Go components and cannot be patched via JAR replacement. Waiting for upstream Elasticsearch update.

CVE-2026-39824 affects golang.org/x/sys only on Windows systems. The vulnerability is in NewNTUnicodeString, which is Windows-specific. Homepage images run on Linux where this code path is not executed.
